hooks.name: Task Progress Tracker
hooks.description: On any tasks.md save, reports progress for the active cloud-dive plan by task group

action.prompt:
A tasks.md file was just saved. Report progress for the active plan `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/tasks.md`. Read that file even if a different tasks.md was saved; `.kiro/specs/aeroicing-watch/tasks.md` is the completed baseline and needs only a one-line count.

1. Count subtasks written as `- [x] N.M` (done) and `- [ ] N.M` (open) for each top-level group 1 to 9. Use the group titles from the file.
2. Active group = first group with an open subtask. Next task = its first open subtask.
3. Name subtasks newly checked since the previous report, if known.
4. Count the C items in `.kiro/specs/cloud-dive/submission-checklist.md` the same way and list the open items that only the owner can do.
5. Remind: every completed task needs a row in `docs/kiro-usage-log.md`.

Format (plain text, no emoji):
Cloud Dive - Task Progress
Overall: X / Y (N percent). Days to deadline (2026-12-04, 2 pm Pacific): D
Group table: group, title, done / total
Active group: ... Next task: ...
Checklist: X / Y done. Owner items open: ...
Baseline (aeroicing-watch): X / Y
Just completed: ... (only if something was newly checked)
Keep it short. Do not invent completions.
